## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Verification

List the checks actually run and any material gaps.

## Screenshots

Embed screenshots here with captions. Required for every PR.
For UI changes, include actual desktop and mobile views of the changed screens;
include before/after views when useful. For API or documentation changes, show
relevant verification output or rendered documentation. Remove secrets and private data.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Screenshots are embedded and accessible to reviewers.
- [ ] Applicable checks passed; unverified behavior is stated.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the change.
- [ ] Branch uses `edw/`; commits use `edwadjei <edd.net49@gmail.com>`.
- [ ] Commits and PR description contain no AI attribution.
- [ ] Merge and deployment await Edward's explicit approval.
